OUR STORY & ETHOS

Driven by Engineering.
Guided by Purpose.

Established to advance modern railway infrastructure, AAV WORKS was founded by a dynamic, result-oriented group of railway engineering professionals. Our mission is to transform the railway signaling landscape by blending proven engineering practices with advanced technologies to deliver fail-safe, standard-compliant design solutions. We specialize in managing railway projects across every milestone, guiding design packages from concept to commissioning with an uncompromising focus on safety, reliability, and timely delivery.

Our core expertise spans conventional yard signaling, Automatic Block Signaling (ABS), modern Electronic Interlocking (EI), and advanced Automatic Train Protection (ATP) systems such as Kavach. Driven by in-depth domain knowledge and strict adherence to RDSO standards, statutory safety directives, and Indian Railway Signal Engineering Manual (IRSEM) guidelines, our team delivers high-precision drawing packages, technical calculations, and interface documentation.

Board of Directors & Domain Experts

Signaling & Telecommunication

Aneelkumar Marathoti

Founder & Managing Director

Aneelkumar Marathoti brings over 16 years of hands-on technical leadership and project design and execution experience across railway signaling, telecommunications, and defense-grade instrumentation. As the Managing Director leading the Signaling & Telecommunication division at AAV Works Pvt. Ltd., he steers strategic operations, system engineering, design validation, and large-scale project commissioning. He is a certified IRSTELO License Holder.

Finance & Governance

B. Kalyani

Director & Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

B. Kalyani serves as Director and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) at AAV Works Pvt. Ltd., steering the company’s corporate governance, fiscal discipline, and strategic financial planning. Working alongside executive leadership, she oversees capital allocation, statutory compliance, risk management, and administrative operations to ensure sustainable business growth and long-term financial stability.

Independent Verification & Validation

A. RangaRao

Principal Consultant

Mr A. RangaRao, Retd. SSE/SIG/S.W.Rly, has been with the company as Principal Consultant since the day it was established, bringing decades of railway signalling domain expertise gained from a distinguished career. At AAV Works, he spearheads the Independent Verification and Validation (V&V) framework, ensuring that all signaling system designs, logic formulations, and safety-critical documentation adhere strictly to Indian Railway Signal Engineering Manual (IRSEM) standards, RDSO guidelines, and CENELEC safety benchmarks.
